name: pyatv-state-update-quiescence-and-semantic-resume
instr:
pyatv cannot hide state updates while a connected AppleTV is reconfigured without pausing transport or protocol work. Add quiescence with one semantic outcome and deterministic accounting. Abort exposes no eligible updates. Terminal lifecycle events remain authoritative.

`StateProducer.quiesce` returns an active `UpdateQuiescence`. Nested scopes share producer ownership; only the outermost resolution releases retained updates in deterministic order. Resume delivers eligible updates, while abort permanently discards them. Every completed scope returns exact `QuiescenceResult` counts, with `observed` covering every classified listener-facing update.

Quiescence affects listener visibility only. State hooks, DataStreamChannel decoding and required replies, CompanionProtocol authentication and response waiters, and partial-frame buffering continue normally. Retained DataStreamChannel, CompanionProtocol, and MessageDispatcher events preserve arrival and dispatch order without splitting delivery across listener replacement. AbstractPushUpdater and CompanionPower reduce scoped state to the final meaningful net change, suppress duplicates and invalid power input, and preserve established asynchronous callback scheduling.

Connection loss supersedes obsolete retained work, preserves the original failure, and produces at most one final device notification. Facade closure permanently prevents later retained delivery. `AppleTV.quiesce_updates` coordinates AirPlay transport, Companion pr
